promised.summary: Trent demonstrates industry-leading store unit economics and flawless execution on Zudio expansion, with minor margin friction from upfront store rollout costs.

promises.target: Open 40–50 new Zudio stores in Q2 FY27
promises.quote: Our property pipeline for Zudio is strong, and we are tracking on plan to add between 40 to 50 stores in the second quarter.
promises.actual: Opened 46 net new Zudio stores in Q2 FY27 across tier-2 and tier-3 locations.

promises.quote: We continue to anchor Westside on steady 5 to 7 percent like-for-like sales growth driven by fresh fashion drops.
promises.actual: Reported 7.2% LFL sales growth across Westside store fleet.

promises.target: Expand beauty & innerwear share above 20% of sales
promises.quote: Emerging concepts including footwear, innerwear, and beauty now constitute over a fifth of our standalone sales and are scaling rapidly.
promises.actual: Emerging categories crossed 21.4% of total standalone retail revenues in Q1 FY27.

promises.quote: While we invest aggressively in new store front-loading, our structural operating margin profile remains anchored near the 15 percent band.
promises.actual: Operating EBIT margin came in at 14.2% due to rapid inventory rollout for new store openings.

snapshot.description: Trent Limited, a Tata Enterprise, is India's fastest-growing value fashion and lifestyle powerhouse operating Westside, Zudio, Misbu, and Star Supermarkets with industry-beating sales per square foot.

cash.note: Direct vendor sourcing and 100% private-label model ensures exceptional working capital velocity and cash generation.

targets.guidance: Add 200+ net new Zudio stores annually
Achieve standalone store-level breakeven across Star formats

bull_points: Zudio's 15-day product refresh cycles recreate the Zara fast-fashion playbook at sub-₹999 price points.
Negative working capital cycle and superior store economics generate massive free cash flow.
Vast runway for expansion into tier-3 and tier-4 Indian consumer clusters.
bear_points: Intensifying competition in value fashion from Reliance Yousta and Aditya Birla Style Up.
Front-loaded store leases and rental inflation in prime tier-1 and tier-2 high-street properties.
